note: The kit mass is the solar array plus the battery only. Air, water, food, habitat, lander, mast and cable mass are not counted. Default load for a crew of 4: crew systems 6.0 kW (1.5 kW each), avionics and communications 1.5 kW, radio to Earth 0.3 kW (only in direct contact), other habitat systems 1.2 kW, science lab 1.0 kW (daylight only): 10 kW in all. Power comes from solar panels and batteries only; nuclear power and fuel cells are not modelled.
